title: Bryan Johnson's Don't Die master protocol: sleep, RHR, exercise, diet, therapies and measurement
summary: Bryan's master protocol page. It centers on lowering resting heart rate before bed for better sleep, then covers 5 core habits, 6 hours a week of exercise, a calorie-restricted plant-heavy diet eaten by noon, his daily schedule, skin/hair/oral care, sauna, HBOT, Rx stack and routine biomarker testing.

principles.text: The single best thing for health is lowering resting heart rate before bed, because it drives sleep, exercise and eating.
principles.quote: Lower your resting heart rate before bed.

principles.text: Eat your last meal four hours before bed so resting heart rate is low and sleep quality is protected.
principles.quote: Eat your final meal/snack of the day four hours before bed.

principles.text: Turn screens off 60 minutes before bed and use a calming wind-down routine such as reading.
Exercise about 6 hours a week: 3 strength and 3 cardio sessions, plus flexibility and balance; make it a non-negotiable habit.
Nutrition philosophy: every calorie must fight for its life; follow evidence and measure biomarkers rather than joining diet camps.
principles.quote: My philosophy on nutrition is that every calorie must fight for its life.

principles.text: Beat bad habits by naming the self-destructive version of you, writing down its persuasion tactics and rebuttals, and setting firm rules.
principles.quote: Make firm rules about what you will and won’t do. **None is easier than some.**
